Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. S Roy, Mr. B K Das,Mr. M H Laskar

Advocate for the Respondent : MR. N UPADHAYAY (SC, IRRIGATION DEPT.), MR. B J TALUKDAR, SC, REVENUE DEPARTMENT,MR. J HANDIQUE,GA, ASSAM  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY  ORDER Date : 28.05.2025 1.
Heard Mr. B.K. Das, learned counsel for the petitioners.

2. It is the case of the petitioner that the possession of the land of the petitioners was taken way back in the year 1983, for Page No.# 3/3 construction of Office Building and Quarters of Irrigation Department in a land acquisition process.
However, when no compensation was paid, this writ petition was filed in the year 2015.

3. In the aforesaid backdrop, the Irrigation Department has taken a stand that as the land acquisition process has in the meantime lapsed in terms of Section 24 of the Fair Compensation Act,
2013, a new proposal for fresh acquisition process has been placed before the concerned District Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 28 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121294548/
2 Collector way back in the month of February, 2025.

4. In the aforesaid backdrop, Mr. H Sarma, learned counsel representing the Collector seeks two weeks time to complete his instructions as regards the follow up action that has been taken on the receipt of requisition from the Irrigation Department.

5. As regards the further claim of the petitioners that 50% of the land earlier acquired is still lying vacant and therefore, the same may be directed to be returned back to the petitioners in terms of Section 96 of the Fair Compensation Act, 2013, Mr. N Upadhyay, learned standing counsel,
Irrigation Department submits that he will complete his instructions in this regard.
6. List this matter after two weeks.
